title: Shared Table
description: Explore food circles, growing, pantry planning and gatherings as a practical doorway into contribution and friendship.
status: Public planning site and browser tools

title: Mate Ecosystem
description: Explore Garden Mate, Kitchen Mate, Fermentation Mate and Event Mate as proposed helpers from growing and cooking to preservation and gatherings.
status: Public concept report; no connected AI service

title: Oceania Healthy De-Slop Co-ops
description: Connect everyday wellbeing, local cooperative possibilities and personal data stewardship across Oceania. Clinics, facilities and specialist research remain proposals.
status: Public proposal and research gateway

title: Community Ledger
description: See how projects, contribution and support can be connected. Read older C-hour material alongside the current non-monetary definition.
status: Public project ledger and concept pathway

title: Quandamooka Country Events Engine
description: Find source-linked events and explore tools for planning, gatherings, stories and aftercare. A listing or plan does not itself confirm a host or permission.
status: Public event catalogue and planning prototype

title: Straddie Noticeboard Network
description: Explore how local notices and screens could help people find activities while publishers retain their own identity. Its sample catalogue is not an enrolled network.
status: Public prototype with sample publisher information

title: Aura of Intelligence
description: Explore the wider Aura vision and how its ideas connect. Start here for the larger picture, then visit Aura Matrix Studio to explore an implementation.
status: Public overview and concept guide

title: Aura Matrix Studio
description: Explore the current Aura interface for personal knowledge, relationships, interests, learning and matrix views. The complete C-hour agent and Sensorium journey remains proposed.
status: Developing browser-local application

title: Straddie Digital Twin Explainer
description: Follow the path from phone scanning to a possible community digital twin, including plain-language explanations of the Sensorium and local shared computing.
status: Public explainer distinguishing built and proposed work

title: Straddie twin prototype
description: Explore an island map, existing panorama records and an illustrative transport exercise. It has no live observation feed and is not a complete reconstructed island.
status: Working browser prototype with limited simulations

title: Ready S.E.T. Co-op Cultural Intelligence Node
description: Explore one local computing node in Dunwich, useful workloads, learning, cultural collaboration and the people who would operate it. The proposed rack is not installed infrastructure.
status: Public proposal and browser-local planning tools

title: Ready S.E.T. Co-op Trust Hub
description: Explore shared employment, learning, mentoring, equipment and administration around local projects. Ready S.E.T. means Sustainable Employment and Training; the cooperative is proposed.
status: Public workbench for a proposed cooperative

title: Minjerribah Site and Service Ideas
description: Explore 7 Mile, Ballow Road, Claytons Road and connected ideas for living, care, culture, making and research. Site access, partnerships and decisions remain with the relevant people.
status: Public workbench for site and service proposals

title: Straddie Clean Energy Superpower
description: Explore energy generation, storage, heat, water and infrastructure questions that could support a more capable island community. The atlas is not an engineered installation plan.
status: Public options atlas and research workbench

title: Mutual Futures
description: Explore willing business succession, shared ownership, Try Everything Once, Intermittent Retirement, Universal Intelligence and more choice across a lifetime.
status: Public proposal with browser-local planning tools

title: 500 Queens Venture Capital
description: Explore women’s enterprise leadership, mentorship and proposed access to backing. AI Queen profiles are creative mentor concepts, and the site does not operate a live investment fund.
status: Public proposal with fictional AI mentor concepts

title: Moreton Bay Community Wealth and Mutuals
description: Explore shared assets, mutual care, Indigenous data sovereignty and community wealth. Financial arrangements have their own development path and do not back a C-hour balance.
status: Public concept and research doorway

title: Stradbroke Grants Lab
description: Connect a local project with possible funding and partner pathways. Source dates, eligibility and readiness need checking for the particular activity.
status: Public funding research workbench

title: P4A civic workbench
description: Explore civic questions, public documents, simulation and constitutional literacy. Participation in C-hours does not require support for P4A or any political party.
status: Public civic prototype; proposed movement

title: P4A Oceania Cinema
description: Explore how civic learning and locally shaped cooperation might connect across Oceania. Older C-hour mechanisms are read through the current planning edition.
status: Public civic idea lab

title: Native Nations of the World
description: Explore source-led discussions of Indigenous data sovereignty, computing and reciprocity. The workbench does not speak for a nation or grant permission on its behalf.
status: Invitational public lab; no representative authority

title: GAJRA Earth
description: Explore the Global Association for Joyful Responsible Abundance on Earth as a possible network of locally shaped projects and associations, with a clear distinction between its archive and current intent.
status: Preserved public concept; association remains unregistered

title: Minjerribah Screen and Media Network
description: Connect stories, skills, screens, local information and practical media activities. The website is an invitation to collaborate, not a confirmed island-wide organisation.
status: Public collaboration proposal

title: Spirit Animal Podcast
description: Explore conversations about values and experience, with guests choosing their own animal and meaning. Production tools help plan and record a conversation without submitting private notes.
status: Public show concept and browser-local production tools

title: Film Club Documentary Builders
description: Keep research, source trails, interview preparation, scene evidence and screening notes organised. A useful starting point for a community story made with its participants.
status: Working browser-local planning toolkit

title: Grain by Grain
description: Follow a long-horizon film ambition connecting place, materials, possible futures and seven-generation civilisation building. Its imagined infrastructure is part of the treatment.
status: Public documentary treatment and planning site

title: DaVinci Resolve Automations
description: Explore reusable editing instructions, visual bundles and AI-assisted production. The guide identifies which proposed controls still need testing on the editing computer.
status: Public production guide; editor integration needs testing

title: Infinity Engine
description: Explore a model-agnostic path from song ideas to lyric videos, comics and other creative outputs, with human direction and review throughout the production process.
status: Development pipeline and public project documentation

title: Project Atlas
description: Find the wider collection and the evidenced relationships between projects. Use it for discovery, then check the destination project’s own status and sources.
status: Working public project map

title: Strange But True Field Library
description: Follow project sources and relationships when an idea needs deeper investigation. The library helps locate evidence; it does not independently validate each claim.
status: Public source and repository research index
